Requirement: "The review-blocked judge derives generated follow-up tracking numbers from the verified PR base and strips judge-provided branch declarations; fenced parent metadata cannot authorize reissue lineage." (agents.md lines 866-870 added by this PR)
Expected change site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh merge_with_followup path, lines 2533-2544 (lineage extraction) and line 2584 (FOLLOWUP_BODY composition)
Evidence of absence: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh is NOT in the PR changed files list. The merge_with_followup path at lines 2533-2544 uses re.search on the raw FIRST_ISSUE_LINEAGE_BODY without any fence/metadata-boundary filtering, so a "Tracking issue:" or "Integration branch:" line inside a code block is extracted as authoritative lineage. Lines 2549-2567 use parent metadata first and only fall back to PR_BASE_REF when parent metadata is absent — the tests expect PR base to be authoritative over mismatched parent metadata. Line 2584 uses FOLLOWUP_BODY verbatim without stripping judge-provided lineage lines. Five tests in tests/test_review_rb_judge_label_propagation.py expect the new behavior: test_merge_with_followup_parent_metadata_wins_over_pr_base_branch (lines 2503-2518) expects PR base #9999 to override parent metadata #4001; test_merge_with_followup_ignores_fenced_tracking_lineage (lines 2521-2530) expects fenced metadata to be ignored; test_merge_with_followup_strips_judge_prose_lineage (lines 2544-2555) expects judge-provided lineage in FOLLOWUP_BODY to be stripped. The close_and_reissue path (lines 2894-2937) has equivalent hardening, which is why test_close_and_reissue_ignores_fenced_orchestrator_footer passes, but the merge_with_followup path was not updated.

  PROBLEM: The merge_with_followup path extracts Integration branch and Tracking issue from FIRST_ISSUE_LINEAGE_BODY using re.search on the full body text with no fence filtering. A "Tracking issue:" or "Integration branch:" line inside a fenced code block or quoted diagnostic is extracted as authoritative lineage, contradicting the security finding's requirement to "Reject branch declarations in diagnostic or quoted content."

The follow-up issue would then resolve to an attacker-controllable branch instead of the independently verified PR base.
